Why don't you come down and get me? //Now//".] [[Next|MomConvo11]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Mom: (//whispers to Dad//) "l think they're trying to get along."] (text-colour:black)[Dad: "Huh? That's great. Good, honey."] [[Next|MomConvo12]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Rodrick: "Okay. Everything is cool here, right, Greg?"] [[Next|MomConvo13]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Greg: "Yeah, Mom. Bye Mom."] [[Next|MomConvo4]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Mom: "Now let me say good night to my little Greg."] [[Next|MomConvo5]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Rodrick: "Greg? Oh, uh. . . He can't. He's totally asleep. l don't want to wake him."] [[Next|MomConvo6]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Greg: "No, l'm not. l'm right here. Hi, Mom. //Hey, Rodrick.//"] [[Next|MomConvo7]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Mom: "Hi, sweetie, is everything okay? Why were you asleep so early? I can never get you to bed on time when I'm home."] [[Next|MomConvo8]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Greg: "(//exhales//) Well, actually, l wasn't sleeping. l'm down in the basement.] [[Next|MomConvo9]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Rodrick: (//chuckles//) "The basement? (text-colour:black)[Mom: Okay, well if you have nothing else to say, I'm going to get Manny ready for bed real quick. Can I call you back in a few minutes?] [[Yes|MomHangsUp]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (dialog: "The next morning") (text-colour:black)[The birds are chirping and the sun peeks through the windows. The boys are fast asleep.] [[Next|NextMorningTwo]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[The house is nearly clean but they notice someone wrote on the bathroom door "RODRICK RULES"] [[Next|NextMorningNine]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Greg remembers when he was in the basement he ran into a door... a perfect white door just like in the bathroom!"] (text-colour:black)[Greg: "Got it!"] [[Next|NextMorningTwelve]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Greg: "You do the living room, l'll start on the kitchen. Go!"] [[Next|NextMorningSix]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Rodrick: "Me? You lied to Mom, just as much as l did. You know how she feels about lying! She's gonna kill both of us!"] [[Next|NextMorningFive]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Greg looks back at the door and realizes... it has no lock. They are so dead.] [[Next|FinalMinigame1]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Greg: "Maybe we just paint over it? Cover it up"] [[Next|NextMorningTen]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Greg tries to find the last chair in the living room and he can't! He looks outside and sees it on the lawn. Before he can get to it, the sprinkler turns on and he jumps to save the chair from getting wet. When he lands, the newspaper boy delivers the paper with a section written by his mother all about her responsible boys. If only she knew...] [[Next|NextMorningEight]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[The boys are cleaning quick. There are red solo cups all around the house, chips all on the floor and drinks spilled everywhere. Who knows how they will pull this off.] [[Next|NextMorningSeven]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Rodrick: "l don't know how to make paint!"] [[Next|NextMorningEleven]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[The boys hustle to screw the door in as their parents pull up into the driveway. They get it secured and run to the living room. They notice it's too clean and throw some chips on the floor to make it feel realistic.] [[Next|NextMorningFourteen]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Greg: "HOLY MOLY. YOU ARE IN SO MUCH TROUBLE!"] [[Next|NextMorningFour]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[They both go into the basement to get the spare door.] (text-colour:black)[Rodrick: "See? lt's a good thing l locked you in the basement!"] [[Next|NextMorningThirteen]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (dialog: "//The phone rings again//") (text-colour:black)[Hi. You've reached the Heffley residence. Please leave a message.] (text-colour:black)[Mom: "Hey, guys. Manny's sick so we're on our way home. See you in an hour."] [[Next|NextMorningThree]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Greg: "Rowley, stop being embarassing! Who would want to Conga anyways? They're all too cool for that!"] [[Next|RodrickScoffs]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Rodrick: "Little bro it's pathetic you thought I would care about what you think"] [[Next|grabChairs]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (set: $likeometer to $likeometer - 1) (text-colour:black)[Ooooh he's gonna make you pay for that later.] [[Next|SetUpHint]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Rodrick shoves Rowley into the basement with Greg... ] (text-colour:black)[Greg looks to Rowley] (text-colour:black)[Greg: "Now what?"] [[Next|PhoneRings]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Rodrick side eyes you, and his crush giggles and walks away] (text-colour:black)[Rodrick: "You're on thin ice buddy... but, thank you for the save"] [[Next|PartyIsDying]](set: $FinalMinigameWon to false) (go-to:"ParentsAreBack")(set: $FinalMinigameWon to true) (go-to:"ParentsAreBack")(enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[And just like that, the front door bursts open.] (text-colour:black)[Dad: Hey guys!] [[Next|ParentsAreBackTwo]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Mom: "Really? Yeah. Surprised me, too. So you just worked it all out by yourselves?"] [[Next|ParentsAreBackNine]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Their dad is wandering slowly around the house looking for any flaws that could disprove what the boys are saying. He notices one of his civil war figurines on the thermostat and yells at them but chalks it up to boys being boys.] [[Next|Win]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Rodrick: (//laughing//) "What? Nobody. You said nobody, Dad. No means no, right?"] [[Next|FinalDecider]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Dad: "So. . . Who came over this weekend?"] [[Next|ParentsAreBackFive]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Rodrick: "Yeah, l guess. l don't know. Mom, don't make a big deal about it..."] [[Next|ParentsAreBackTen]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Rodrick: "Yeah, actually. You know, l never thought l'd admit this, but we had a pretty good time together."] (if: $likeometer is 5) [ (text-colour:black)[Rodrick: "I really appreciate you little bro. I guess you're kinda cool after all."]] (else:) [ (text-colour:black)[Rodrick scoffs and rolls his eyes. He definitely said that as a joke...]] [[Next|ParentsAreBackEight]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Dad: "Yeah, yeah. So, you guys just hung out? Had a good time?"] [[Next|ParentsAreBackSeven]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Mom: "Okay. Okay. Nothing makes me happier than to see you two being friends."] [[Next|ParentsAreBackEleven]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Mom: "Yeah. He's doing okay. Wow. The house looks pretty good. l was expecting a big mess. Who ate chips on the rug?"] (text-colour:black)[The boys chuckle nervously.] [[Next|ParentsAreBackFour]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Rodrick: Hey, Mom, Dad. Hey, how's Manny? ls he feeling better? Poor guy."] [[Next|ParentsAreBackThree]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[Dad: "The gig is up Rodrick. I know that lamp moved, and there's no reason you would've moved it i it was just the two of you."] (text-colour:black)[Rodrick: "I...Uh...Um"] [[Next|ParentsFindOut2]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (text-colour:black)[You can feel Rodrick staring daggers into your soul as he lounders.] (text-colour:black)[Rodrick: "Well I guess we were both caught in a lie then."] (text-colour:black)[You want to curl up into a ball now. You guys were so close... If only you had remembered the right layout...] [[Play Again?|Launch]](enchant:?page,(bg:white)) (set: $likeometer to $likeometer +1) (text-colour:black)[Mom: "The house better be intact when we come
